title: Standardized platform error
description: Every non-2xx reply from the shared core is this object and nothing else. Codes are a closed set so a caller can branch without parsing prose. A rejected request never carries partial success, and the message never echoes a credential, dataset path or SQL fragment.

message.description: Short, stable, non-sensitive explanation. No dataset key, path, token or SQL text.

retryable.description: True only when an identical retry can succeed without operator action. A non-idempotent task whose outcome is unknown is never retryable.

field.description: Optional pointer to the offending request field, dotted path form.

requestID.description: Correlation id echoed back so a caller can find the server log without being told internals.

allOf.description: An unknown-side-effect outcome is never presented as safe to retry automatically.
Authentication and authorization failures are never advertised as retryable.
